text:
Situation: The amino acid injection product is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 21 bags, providing 4.8 days of supply at a 4.4 bags-per-day usage rate. Corvale General holds 63 bags, providing 14 days of supply at a 4.5 bags-per-day usage rate. No public FDA signal has been issued for the plants supplying our sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the product is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both sites, but Corvale East supply is below one week. Absence from the FDA list does not guarantee uninterrupted supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and manufacturer communications daily; report changes to P&T Committee Chair for awareness.
2. Buyer to request allocation status and estimated release dates from the manufacturer; share data with P&T Committee for review.
3. Buyer to evaluate secondary suppliers and initiate qualification if viable; requires P&T Committee approval before purchasing.
4. Buyer to coordinate with Corvale East and General pharmacy leads on conservation tactics; requires P&T Committee endorsement.

Not recommended: Initiating formulary changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
